name: Kanojo x Kanojo x Kanojo Dokidoki Full Throttle!
original_name: 彼女×彼女×彼女　ドキドキ フルスロットル！
source:
One year has passed since Haruomi has gone to live in the house of the three Orifushi sisters, Natsumi, Akina and Mafuyu. Again one year has passed since he has began to go to Akina's school where he has made the acquaintance of Midori, his class president, and of Suzuran, a girl who very rarely tells something.
In this game we see the stories of what has happened after this year. How will the relationship of the protagonist with each heroine be changed?
translation:
距离春臣住进织节三姐妹——夏实、秋奈与真冬的家中，转眼已过去一年；他转入秋奈就读的学园也同样满了一年，并在校内结识了班长翠，以及平日里惜字如金的少女铃兰。
本作将描绘这一年之后上演的崭新日常：主人公与各位女主角之间的关系又将迎来怎样的进展？
